name: Gold Coast / Broadwater & Seaway, Qld · terrain test
verticalDatum: Australian Vertical Working Surface (AVWS, EPSG:9458). Initial sea level is a hypothetical AVWS plane, not calibrated local mean sea level.
source: CSIRO Queensland estuaries composite topography-bathymetry v1 (5 m source grid)
attribution: Branson, Paul; Hally, Bryan; & Steven, Andy (2025): Composite Topography-Bathymetry Digital Elevation Model for Queensland Estuaries. v1. CSIRO. Data Collection. https://doi.org/10.25919/1xzm-pw88
changes: Reprojected cell centres from EPSG:7856 to EPSG:9473; nearest 5 m source pixel sampled at each 50 m model cell centre; source flags retained; elevations rounded to 1 mm. No vertical datum mixing or local gap filling.
sampling: 50 m centre sampling from a 5 m composite; narrow channels can be unresolved
note: Composite includes interpolated terrain, modelled creek depths and coarse base data, not only surveys. All elevations retain AVWS; tide is a hypothetical plane. Missing cells are excluded from flow. No verified offshore tsunami forcing, tide calibration or hazard validation.
